My wife and I ordered four sets of the 60 x 24 x 78 ones for an indoor 10 x 10 storage unit. The shelving units are pretty exact to dimensions. The directions were accurate after we built the first one, per the instructions, but we discovered that tapping in each level and placing the shelving material as we progressed up, made things much easier and quicker to assemble. The shelving units are very sturdy for their weight capacity without weighing too much to move around. We definitely liked the ability to adjust each shelf to our needs. We would definitely recommend this unit if everything meets your needs, and definitely for the price. We would suggest that you get an actual rubber mallet, instead of counting on the one that comes with it, because it's quite small and a little lightweight. Don't use a metal hammer, because it will dent and mar the finish and possibly damage the structure.

Works perfectly to hold three 40 gallon breeder tanks. Sturdy and easy to put together. The mallet that comes with it is very handy and helps with assembly. I like the included hooks to hang the extra shelf on the side if not used. It seemed a little flimsy at first. But once I added weight, it became more sturdy and flexed less.

This hand swager was recently purchased as a gift for my son who lives on a ranch in rural Montana with lots of fence on the property. The tool was promptly shipped/delivered and appears to be of a quality similar to other brands costing considerably more. The tool operates as expected and also included a gauge (not shown in advertising) for measuring the sleeves.

J’ai acheté cette pince pour sertir des cables de 3 mm pour un garde corps. Cette pince est inefficace pour ce diamètre car une fois fermé, le sertissage n’est pas fini et le câble ressent de celui-ci. J’ai été obligé de rajouter un clou entre la pince et l’embout à sertir afin que celui-ci soit serti correctement. Sinon matériel convenable de très bonne qualité mais pas pour le 3 mm.
